approved_scope.title: Never read or write the hash cache through a symbolic link
approved_scope.description: Never read or write the hash cache through a symbolic link
acceptance_criteria: With .specsync/hashes.json, or .specsync itself, as a symbolic link to a path outside the repository, specsync check and specsync rehash leave the link's target byte for byte unchanged and create nothing through it; check keeps its verdict and exit code and prints one stderr warning that the hash cache was not saved; rehash exits 1 and names the link; load returns an empty cache without reading through a link; a regular cache is replaced by a temp file in .specsync renamed over it; the new tests fail on 3bebe8b0 and pass with the fix

answers.constraints: hash_cache.3md 'Conservative on uncertainty': an unusable cache may only cause more validation, so a cache location that is a link or not a regular file reads as an empty cache. cmd_check.3md: the cache is persisted only with zero errors and a skip is never a claim that nothing was wrong, so a cache that was not saved is said on stderr and never changes the verdict.
